title: Rényi Phase Transitions and Analytic Continuation to the von Neumann Entropy
summary: Extracting operationally meaningful quantities such as von Neumann entropy and mutual information is central to characterizing many-body quantum systems, yet experiments and numerics often provide direct access only to integer Rényi entropies. Whereas conventional extrapolation relies on a prescribed fitting ansatz, in PRL 137, 100202 we introduced an alternative approach based on stabilized analytic continuation (SAC), which avoids such an ansatz and is inherently robust to noise.
